What CBC Promises vs. What Your Child Actually Needs

CBC curriculum gaps in Kenya, digital literacy on paper, critical thinking in practice. What parents should supplement.

CBC promised competency, creativity, and real-world skills. Parents searching CBC curriculum gaps Kenya are finding a different reality in many schools: new labels on old methods, portfolio folders, and limited capacity for the creative, technology-integrated learning CBC describes.

Digital literacy was added to the curriculum. But who is teaching children to question the algorithm, not just click it?

Schools teach tool use. Children need tool judgment.

Schools assess outputs. Children need to defend process.

Schools follow schemes of work. Children need open-ended creation.

Supplementing CBC does not mean rejecting school. It means giving your child environments where competency is practiced, not just documented.
